content.text: Overall A- Matriculation B Academics A Extracurriculars B+ Geo & Community B Reviews A+ Founded in 1912, Montverde Academy is the premier day and boarding school in Central Florida. Our beautiful campus is located 30 minutes west of Orlando, Florida. The academy serves Pre-K3 through 12th grade as well as a post-graduate year with a boarding program that begins in 7th grade. We have a total enrollment of 1320 students, that includes 350 boarding students that that hail from 89 different nations! With a 100% college acceptance rate, Montverde Academy provides students with a strong educational foundation that will fully prepare them for their path to middle and upper school and beyond! We inspire students to become knowledgeable leaders with global vision and a passion for learning in a disciplined and diverse community. We encourage you to delve deeper into the many opportunities offered by the Academy by exploring our website, where you will learn more about the Academy's philosophy, curriculum, athletics and fine arts and media programs. Our Music Conservatory and athletic programs consistently compete at national levels. The Academy offers Subject Area Concentration certifications in six different study areas, along with 32 AP courses and 13 Honors classes. Extracurricular activities for students include assemblies, publications, honor societies, clubs, educational trips, student leadership and community service. Frequently Ask Questions about Montverde Academy Show all Tell me a bit about Montverde Academy. Montverde Academy is Co-ed private boarding school located in Florida, US. It was founded 1912 , and currently has about 1400 students, 20.00% of whom are international students. For more official information, please visit http://www.montverde.org. Does Montverde Academy have rigorous academic requirements? Montverde Academy is offering 30 AP courses. In recent years, 27 of their students score 4 and 5 in AP exams. Montverde Academy also have 78% of faculties whose degrees are master and above. Where do Montverde Academy students typically go for their colleges? Based on the most recent matriculation data, 11.71% go to top 50 US universities and colleges*, 1.95% go to top 25, and about 0.98% go to Harvard, Yale, Princeton, Stanford and MIT. *Ranking is based on the 2024 US News College Ranking. What is the application requirement for Montverde Academy? Similar to most private schools in the US, Montverde Academy’s typical admission requirements include school transcript, recommendation letter, application essay, TOEFL for international students, and interview (often optional, but highly recommended). What is the Boarding Tuition for Montverde Academy? The total fee for Montverde Academy in 2024 is $58,815 which typically includes tuition, boarding fee, student management fee and a few other fees associated with managing international students. For more information, please contact school’s admission team at admissions@montverde.org . Where is Montverde Academy located? Montverde Academy is located in the State of Florida of USA.
